content.comment_body: Hello, I have a question for more experienced users. I'm testing several [product_name] modules and things are working well so far. I need to create a large page displaying information from these modules, starting with simple buttons. Red buttons are read-only and reflect input from memory flags, while green buttons are network inputs. When I separate the buttons across multiple pages, everything functions fine—I can change values with green buttons and see feedback from memory flags. But when I place all buttons on one page, I can still change values but do not receive updates from memory flags (although in the control software's online mode, the input appears as expected). Is there a limit to how many objects can be added to one page, or could there be another issue I'm missing?

From my experience, I am unaware of any strict limits in [product_name] Web Editor. However, transmission speed and the choice of browser may impact performance. You did not specify which [product_name] module you are using.
Thank you for your response. All modules are 230V, probably the newest versions with firmware version [version_no]. I tried different browsers and devices, but I encountered the same issue.

If your modules are 230 VAC or other types such as 24 VDC, that likely isn't the issue. In my view, the issue relates to using the latest [product_name] version [version_no]. Previous versions, like [version_no], did not exhibit these problems.

Yes, I am using version [version_no]. Based on my testing, the maximum number of digital buttons (push or switch type) is 16—above this, switch buttons no longer update their value on the page. Edit: The limit appears to be 16 objects connected to [product_name]; beyond this, feedback from the device is not received.

I've attached a screen video and also the program for the [product_name] and the [product_name] Web Editor project for version [version_no]. You can observe that I'm using more than 16 digital values—three cams on the weekly timer and seven weekdays, totaling 21 digital values. For testing, I use Firefox browser. With Google Chrome, this does not work as intended.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum users are facing a limitation with the number of interactive objects that can be added to a single page within the [product_name] Web Editor when connecting to [product_name] version [version_no]. Once the number of linked objects, such as toggle buttons, exceeds around 16, updates from device memory flags stop appearing in the web interface. The issue may also be influenced by browser compatibility, as behavior seems different between browsers like Firefox and Chrome.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to add a large number of interactive objects to one page and receive real-time feedback from connected modules without running into data update limits. They also anticipate compatibility across various browsers and devices.
